values.note: 2027 on the booking site: $48 a night at every Dunes site; 2026: $45 (DNR rates table). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Petoskey State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483532: all 78 Dunes campsites on fee schedule -32475, $45 for 2026-11-17, $48 for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Petoskey, Dunes: Modern camping 20/30 AMP rate $45) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/petoskey (Recreation Passport required for vehicle entry), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/petoskey (Dunes: 'There is 20- and 30-amp service available on each site.') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (all 78 Dunes campsites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps', 'Sewer Hookup=No'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Smaller sites 'ideal for tent, van or compact campers'. The booking site allows trailers/RVs up to 25 ft at 24 of the 78 sites and up to 20 ft at 32; the other 22 take only tents or truck campers. No pull-throughs listed. The park's Tannery Creek campground (98 paved sites, to 40 ft) is separate.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/petoskey (Petoskey Dunes Modern Campground: 'smaller sites ideal for tent, van or compact campers'; 'Number of sites: 78'; Tannery Creek: 'paved pads at each site', 'Number of sites: 98') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Dunes map: 78 campsites; allowed equipment 'Trailer or RV up to 25'' at 24, 'up to 20'' at 32, 'Tents'/'Truck Camper' only at 22; all 'Pull Through=No'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/petoskey (Petoskey Dunes Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Petoskey, Dunes: reservation season starts 'May 15', ends 'September 30') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (78 bookable Dunes campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: The smaller of Petoskey State Park's two campgrounds, 3 mi NE of Petoskey on Little Traverse Bay; family atmosphere, many sites shaded by cedars, and a short trail to the Lake Michigan day-use beach. Old Baldy Dune and Portage trails in the park; the Little Traverse Wheelway passes the entrance. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + rates table: $45 -> $48 (2027; 2026 $45 confirmed), 20/30-amp electric (new, 30), no sewer (new), 78 sites (was 70), max 25 ft (new), showers, flush toilets, dump, potable water (new); reservable on MiDNRReservations (confirmed); reservation season May 15 - Sept 30 confirmed (derived -> manual). No page states the operating season, so season stays absent. Status open left (no closure notice on the park page; the 2025 sewer/road closure is over). Phone 231-347-2311 matches. Note rewritten: dropped the field restatements, the past 2025 closure text and 'paved' (the paved pads are Tannery Creek's).
flags: Rig length: the Dunes campground's largest sites take a trailer/RV of 25 ft (24 of 78 sites on MiDNRReservations; 32 more are capped at 20 ft and 22 take tents or truck campers only); the DNR calls them 'smaller sites ideal for tent, van or compact campers'. A 23-ft rig fits, with little margin. The park's other campground, Tannery Creek (98 paved sites, allowed to 40 ft, $48-53 in 2027), is not in the database as its own entry.
